name: Warden Jericho
desc:
Warden Jericho is an Adret NPC. He is a high-ranking official within [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) as the head of its Eastern garrison.

He appears as an aged Adretian man with red eyes and markings, with a faded scar on his right eye. His hair is a dark blue color, and is combed back precisely to reach the back of his neck, with his bangs asymmetrically leaning towards the right. To the right of his head is a glowing white "crown" in the shape of three four-pronged stars connected with each other, likely as a result of being a Warmaster.

Much like the rest of him, his personality is still a mystery. Unlike most members of the Authority, he appears to actually pity the [Etreans](faction:etrea), knowing that [The Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent) is dragging them into this 'war they cannot understand' and sees their Lord Regent as a 'thing' rather than a person.

He dons a red Royal Duelist and is clad over a Authority Captain Uniform. A gold-colored Warmaster's Medallion sits on his neck and a pair of Vanguard Boots on his feet. He holsters a bell on his hip, signifying his strength to obtain a Resonance. On his other hip, he wields the Rite of Authority.
additional_info:
-   The Oath wielded by Warden Jericho, Warmaster, is unreleased.
-   When he executes the Pathfinder by lowering their cage into the sea, Warden Jericho's textbox doesn't use his title, and instead refers to him as just "Jericho".
